items.note: Spec check issue 2: BlurHashTest holds the 32x32 preview as 1 024 ARGB ints; PreviewLoaderTest uses a counting fake decode, and BitmapPreviews.kt (Android code the JVM tests cannot run) is covered only by the 1920x1080 device screenshots. Spec check issue 4: the new six-prop expectations here and T3-11's frozen five-prop tests (scripts/tv-artwork-module.test.ts, ModuleSurfaceTest.kt, apps/tv/src/host/native-artwork.test.tsx) cannot both be green, so pnpm check stays red from this freeze until the Product Owner rules on item 8; milestone 0 (returning those files) precedes every other commit. The Kotlin runs are red at the freeze because the artwork test source set does not compile without BlurHash and PreviewLoader, so every modules/artwork JVM test is red until milestone 1.

items.why: Documents: decision 0005's T3-39 amendment, docs/security.md and ARCHITECTURE.md name the sixth prop as the hash string only, and the PR body has a 'Changed native surface' section. No test reads document wording. The surface itself is held by item 1's tests (scripts/tv-artwork-preview.test.ts refuses a blurHashUrl or previewUrl prop) and by T3-11's frozen scans for url, headers, token and source once the Product Owner rules on item 8.

items.note: Where the hash comes from (ImageBlurHashes[type][tag] for the drawn ref) is already held by packages/core/src/jellyfin/cards.test.ts; the core adds nothing. The no-hash and no-session cases pass at the freeze as T3-11 behaviour; the hashed-ref cases are red. T3-08's frozen media-card.test.tsx item 6 still holds the title on a failed slot.

The bound is 166 characters. The refusal classes are tested one by one, with 167, 168 and 10 000 characters for the bound; the 2 000 random strings use seed 39. A size flag above 80 (numY of 10) is not pinned: the spec's validation list does not name it, and the random test only requires null or 1 024 ints without a throw. Off the UI thread: PreviewLoaderTest runs the decode on an injected single-thread dispatcher. No network: PreviewSourceTest and the frozen ArtworkModuleSourceTest.

Spec check issue 6: the reference woltapp/blurhash at 712a47f946b98c30097eb1ada086ea00b18681ec is MIT (License.md at that commit, read through the GitHub API on 2026-11-23 before it was run); the fixture's own source field records it, and the implementer's README entry for blurhash-vectors.json should repeat it. The 1x1 vectors are derived by hand; the README, 9x9 and Jellyfin fixture vectors come from one run of the reference at 32x32 outside the repository, and no code of it is committed. The 9x9 hash is built for the file (its from field says how).

Animated.timing is spied; a started timing jumps its value to toValue, so a recycled card's fresh value is told apart from an animated one. The DESIGN.md wording and the 1920x1080 before and after screenshots are for review. Spec check issue 5: every hashed card fades over 480 ms on each remount, including a picture-cache hit; the PR lists this for the owner's veto with D4.

items.why: Frame figures under a held key need the implementer's own emulator (Android TV API 36, 1920x1080): three cold runs per build of gfxinfo after the fixed Down and Right key script, on origin/main 3e692771 and on the task head with the same fixture Home layout. Pass: median janky share within 2 percentage points and 90th percentile within 2 ms of the baseline (Product Owner ruling, 2026-11-23). Spec check issue 1 is fixed first: the fixture Home's hashed cards carry distinct valid hashes and enough rows that cards decode and recycle under a held Down. Both builds' figures go in the spec's Implementation record; a miss returns to the Product Owner. Supporting JVM tests: PreviewLoaderTest (one decode per hash, a synchronous cached hit, eviction by bytes within 1 MiB).

A process rule: no T3-39 commit touches a file in docs/specs/T3-11.tests.json. The three frozen T3-11 files that pin five props are returned to the Product Owner at milestone 0 and change only by a Product Owner commit with Frozen-Test-Change trailers; pnpm lint:flow fails any other change, and the PR's Frozen tests section names each ruled change.
